says: In today's CI tooling, the scheduled full run's report read a leg that ran into its 17-minute limit as stopped, so a red main opened no ci-scheduled issue. GitHub ends a timed-out leg cancelled with its test step cancelled, the same as a leg another leg's stop step canceled, and the verdict was red only on a failure. Fixed in pull request 1319: a leg canceled at or past its job's limit is a time-out, red, and named in the issue.
proof: Run 43723335863 on main, started by hand while main was red on a schedule-only law: legs next (4) and next (e2e-1) ran 17 min 20 s and 17 min 17 s, their vitest and end to end steps ended cancelled, and the report job succeeded and opened no issue. Their check-run annotations say the job exceeded the maximum execution time of 17m0s.
cost: A red main stayed out of sight, with no sev1 issue, until someone looked at the run by hand.
